The campaign forced more than 700,000 Rohingya to flee to Bangladesh amid mass killings, sexual violence and the destruction of villages.
The landmark ruling marks the first time the ICJ has found a state responsible for genocide and could set a precedent for South Africa’s genocide case against Israel over Gaza.
